description: This PHP source file defines the HomePageService class within the OrangeHRM project, providing methods to retrieve default paths for various modules and the user's home page, utilizing traits for user role management.

classes.name: HomePageService
classes.description: Service class providing methods to retrieve user home page and module default paths based on user roles.

methods.description: Returns the path to the user's home page based on their role.
